title: Add complex financial fee calculator
description: Introduce tier-based fee calculation with boundary discounts.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+def calculate_tiered_fee(amount: float, tier: int) -> float:
+    if amount <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("Amount must be positive")
+    if tier == 1:
+        return amount * 0.05
+    elif tier == 2:
+        return amount * 0.035
+    elif tier == 3:
+        return amount * 0.02
+    else:
+        return amount * 0.015

notes: New critical financial logic added without accompanying test files.

title: Fix token expiration verification
description: Check if token timestamp is older than validity window.

files.patch:
@@ -20,4 +20,4 @@ def is_token_expired(created_at: float, ttl_seconds: float) -> bool:
     current_time = time.time()
-    return current_time > (created_at + ttl_seconds)
+    return current_time < (created_at + ttl_seconds)

notes: Logic inverted: '<' instead of '>' causes active tokens to be marked expired and expired tokens marked valid.
